description: Create a professional website, redesign one you already have, or build a web app simply by chatting. Describe what you need or share your current website URL. Revamp builds a working preview you can review and refine. Add pages and features such as bookings, payments, and customer accounts. When you're ready, publish on your own domain and keep improving the same project.

defaultPrompt: Create a modern website for my law firm with practice areas, attorney profiles, and a consultation form.
Redesign my website to make a stronger first impression and get more client inquiries.
Build a client booking web app for my consultancy with available time slots and an intake form.
interface.longDescription: Create a professional website, redesign one you already have, or build a web app simply by chatting. Describe what you need or share your current website URL. Revamp builds a working preview you can review and refine. Add pages and features such as bookings, payments, and customer accounts. When you're ready, publish on your own domain and keep improving the same project.

name: revamp

positive.description: Create a law firm website and see the preview.
positive.prompt: Create a modern website for my law firm with practice areas, attorney profiles, and a consultation form.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a fresh UUID as requestId. start_new_website returns projectId and submissionId. Poll check_project with both IDs. When the turn completes, report its reply and public revamp.page preview if available. A submitted turn alone is not a ready preview.

positive.description: Redesign an existing website to make a stronger first impression.
positive.prompt: Redesign https://revamp.dev/ to make a stronger first impression and encourage more visitors to start a project. Keep the key content and show me the preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Use https://revamp.dev/ as the public source URL and a fresh requestId. The start tool returns projectId and submissionId. Poll check_project with both IDs, then present the customer-facing reply and public preview when available.

positive.description: Build a client booking web app for a consultancy.
positive.prompt: Build a client booking web app for my consultancy with available time slots and an intake form.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a fresh requestId. start_web_app returns projectId and submissionId. Poll check_project with both IDs until the turn finishes, then present its reply and public preview when available. Inspect the actual app behavior separately.

positive.description: Refine an existing website without creating a new project.
positive.prompt: In my project named Meridian Advisory, change the homepage heading to “Welcome to Meridian Advisory” and show me the updated preview.
positive.expected_behavior: list_projects finds the pre-existing Meridian Advisory project. Pass its projectId and a fresh requestId to refine_project, then use the returned submissionId with check_project. The same projectId is retained. Report the agent reply; an existing preview may still show the previous version until the new build is available.

positive.description: Find recent projects and return to an existing website.
positive.prompt: Show my recent Revamp projects and where I can continue editing Meridian Advisory.
positive.expected_behavior: list_projects returns only this account’s recent Studio V2 projects, including the pre-existing Meridian Advisory project, its projectId, and its studioUrl. Do not create or modify a project.

negative.description: Website copy ideas only; no Revamp project requested.
negative.prompt: Give me five headline ideas for a bakery homepage.

negative.description: Instructions for an unrelated hosting platform.
negative.prompt: How do I deploy an existing Next.js site to Netlify?

negative.description: Compare other website builders without starting a project.
negative.prompt: Compare Wix and Squarespace for a photography portfolio.

de-DE.description: Erstelle eine professionelle Website, gestalte deine bestehende neu oder entwickle eine Web-App – einfach im Gespräch mit Revamp. Beschreibe dein Vorhaben oder teile die Adresse deiner aktuellen Website. Prüfe und verfeinere die funktionierende Vorschau, ergänze Seiten, Buchungen, Zahlungen oder Kundenkonten und veröffentliche das Ergebnis auf deiner eigenen Domain. Dein Projekt lässt sich jederzeit weiterentwickeln.
de-DE.subtitle: Websites erstellen & erneuern

nl-NL.description: Maak een professionele website, vernieuw je bestaande site of bouw een webapp, gewoon via de chat. Beschrijf wat je wilt of deel de URL van je huidige website. Bekijk en verfijn een werkende preview, voeg pagina’s en functies zoals boekingen, betalingen en klantaccounts toe, en publiceer op je eigen domein. Ook daarna kun je je project blijven verbeteren.
nl-NL.subtitle: Websites maken of vernieuwen

sv-SE.description: Skapa en professionell hemsida, förnya din nuvarande eller bygg en webbapp – bara genom att chatta med Revamp. Beskriv vad du behöver eller dela adressen till din befintliga hemsida. Granska och förbättra en fungerande förhandsvisning, lägg till sidor, bokningar, betalningar och kundkonton och publicera på din egen domän. Fortsätt utveckla projektet när du vill.
sv-SE.subtitle: Skapa eller förnya hemsidor

fr-FR.description: Créez un site professionnel, repensez votre site actuel ou développez une application web, simplement en discutant avec Revamp. Décrivez votre projet ou partagez l’adresse de votre site. Examinez et affinez un aperçu fonctionnel, ajoutez des pages, des réservations, des paiements ou des comptes clients, puis publiez sur votre propre domaine. Continuez à faire évoluer le même projet quand vous le souhaitez.
fr-FR.subtitle: Créer ou refondre un site web

es-ES.description: Crea un sitio web profesional, rediseña el que ya tienes o desarrolla una aplicación web conversando con Revamp. Describe lo que necesitas o comparte la URL de tu sitio actual. Revisa y perfecciona una vista previa funcional, añade páginas, reservas, pagos o cuentas de clientes y publica en tu propio dominio. Después podrás seguir mejorando el mismo proyecto.
es-ES.subtitle: Crear o rediseñar sitios web

it-IT.description: Crea un sito web professionale, rinnova quello che hai già o realizza una web app semplicemente parlando con Revamp. Descrivi ciò che desideri o condividi l’URL del tuo sito attuale. Esamina e perfeziona un’anteprima funzionante, aggiungi pagine, prenotazioni, pagamenti o account clienti e pubblica sul tuo dominio. Continua a migliorare lo stesso progetto quando vuoi.
it-IT.subtitle: Crea o rinnova siti web

ja-JP.description: Revampと会話するだけで、プロ仕様のWebサイトを新規作成したり、既存サイトをリニューアルしたり、Webアプリを構築したりできます。希望を伝えるか、現在のサイトのURLを共有してください。動作するプレビューを確認・調整し、ページ、予約、決済、顧客アカウントなどを追加。独自ドメインで公開した後も、同じプロジェクトを改善し続けられます。
ja-JP.subtitle: Webサイトを作成・リニューアル

ko-KR.description: Revamp와 대화하며 전문적인 웹사이트를 새로 만들거나 기존 사이트를 재설계하고 웹 앱을 구축하세요. 원하는 내용을 설명하거나 현재 사이트의 URL을 공유하면 됩니다. 작동하는 미리보기를 확인하고 다듬은 뒤 페이지, 예약, 결제, 고객 계정 등을 추가하고 내 도메인에 게시하세요. 게시 후에도 같은 프로젝트를 계속 개선할 수 있습니다.
ko-KR.subtitle: 웹사이트 제작 또는 리디자인

ar.description: أنشئ موقعاً احترافياً، أو أعد تصميم موقعك الحالي، أو ابنِ تطبيق ويب بمجرد الحوار مع Revamp. صف ما تحتاج إليه أو شارك رابط موقعك الحالي. راجع معاينة تعمل بالفعل وحسّنها، وأضف صفحات وحجوزات ومدفوعات وحسابات للعملاء، ثم انشر على نطاقك الخاص. ويمكنك مواصلة تطوير المشروع بعد النشر.
ar.subtitle: أنشئ موقعك أو أعد تصميمه

zh-TW.description: 只要與 Revamp 對話，就能建立專業網站、重新設計現有網站，或打造網頁應用程式。描述需求或提供現有網站網址，查看並調整可實際操作的預覽。加入頁面、預約、付款及客戶帳號等功能，再以自己的網域發布。發布後仍可持續完善同一個專案。
zh-TW.subtitle: 建立或重新設計網站

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create or redesign business websites by chatting, then preview and refine the project.
